2 SESSIONS JUDGE, AT HOLALKERE FOR THE OFFENCE  -3-  NC: 2026:KHC:13451  CRL.RP No. 369 of 2026 HC-KAR PUNISHABLE UNDER SECTION 465, 468, 420 R/W 34 OF IPC AND ALSO ORDER DATED 04.10.2025 PASSED BY THE PRL.DISTRICT AND SESSIONS JUDGE, AT CHITRADURGA, FOR THE OFFENCE PUNISHABLE UNDER SECTION 465,468,420 R/W 34 OF INDIAN PENAL CODE IN CRL.A.NO.28/2020.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE V SRISHANANDA  ORAL ORDER Heard Sri K. Nageshwarappa, learned High Court Government Pleader for the revision petitioner.
2.

State is the revision petitioner challenging the order of acquittal passed by the learned Trial Magistrate in C.C.No.253/2008 acquitting the accused for the offences punishable under Section 420, 465 and 468 r/w Section 149 of Indian Penal Code which was confirmed in Crl.A.No.28/2020.

3. Taking note of the concurrent findings of the fact that the prosecution failed to establish any one of the ingredient to attract the offence punishable under Section 420, 465 and 468 of Indian Penal Code, this Court in the revisional jurisdiction does not find any good grounds to admit the appeal for further consideration.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER (i) Admission is declined.
(ii) Revision petition is dismissed.

Sd/-
